Task: Add the correct movie posters to my existing CineNova website

Edit my existing CineNova HTML website. Do not redesign the whole website or remove any existing features.

1. Add the movie poster images

Create or use the existing posters/ folder in the website's root directory. Add the correct official or properly licensed portrait poster for each movie using these exact filenames:

  1. posters/peddi.jpg — Peddi

  2. posters/mana-shankara-vara-prasad-garu.jpg — Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu

  3. posters/irumudi.jpg — Irumudi

  4. posters/anaganaga-oka-raju.jpg — Anaganaga Oka Raju

  5. posters/hanuman.jpg — HanuMan (2024)

  6. posters/bethlehem-kudumba-unit.jpg — Bethlehem Kudumba Unit

  7. posters/drishyam-3.jpg — Drishyam 3

  8. posters/vaazha-ii.jpg — Vaazha II

  9. posters/aadu-3.jpg — Aadu 3

  10. posters/patriot.jpg — Patriot

2. Match posters to the correct movie cards

Keep each poster attached to its matching movie title. Do not change the existing movie order, language filters, search bar, IMDb links, release years, or other card information.

My existing JavaScript generates poster paths using posters/ plus a filename derived from each movie title. Keep that behaviour compatible with the filenames above, or update the mapping to use an explicit poster filename for every movie.

3. Image layout and appearance

  • Use portrait posters with a 2:3 aspect ratio.

  • Fill each movie card using object-fit: cover and object-position: center.

  • Keep the existing rounded corners, dark navy background, gold highlights, cyan accents, hover animation, and card layout.

  • Keep the movie title, language label, IMDb link, release year, and gross text readable above the poster.

  • Use lazy loading for poster images.

  • Add a graceful fallback if an image is missing or fails to load; never show a broken-image icon.

  • Do not put one poster on multiple unrelated movie cards.

  • Do not use generated lookalike posters when an authentic poster is available.

4. Accuracy and testing

  • Use a matching, verified poster for each title and year.

  • Do not invent IMDb ratings, box-office collections, or release information.

  • Do not label TMDB ratings as IMDb ratings.

  • Test all ten movie cards, search, language tabs, desktop layout, and mobile layout.

  • Confirm that every poster loads from the correct path and that no existing website feature is broken.

Deliverable: Return the updated working HTML project and all ten poster image files in the posters/ folder. If you cannot retrieve or license a particular poster, clearly identify which one is missing instead of silently substituting another movie's image.

Important: Your HTML already references the poster filenames above, so correctly named files should fit into the existing movie cards. If you deploy the website online, make sure the posters/ folder is uploaded alongside the HTML file.

For live movie data and posters that update automatically, you can also use the TMDB developer API instead of maintaining all ten image files manually.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
